answer.title: Square Pricing: Plans & Fees for Small Businesses | Square
answer.text:
Simple, transparent pricing for in-person payments

No monthly fee for the Free software plan. Pay only for what you process.

In-person processing: 2.6% + 15¢ per tap, dip or swipe transaction. Keyed-in transactions: 3.5% + 15¢.

Software plans
Free: $0/mo. Core point-of-sale features, inventory basics, and reporting for one location.
Plus: $29/mo per location. Adds staff management, advanced reporting, and priority support.
Premium: Custom pricing. For businesses with multiple locations and complex needs.

Hardware
Square Reader (contactless and chip): $59.
Square Terminal: $299.
Square Register: $699 for the full register bundle.
Square Stand: $149.

Hardware prices are one-time purchases. Some devices are also available through monthly financing with approved credit. Prices exclude tax and shipping. Processing rates may vary for certain card types and sales channels.

Sign up for free or log in to see your current plan and rates.

answer.title: Clover Pricing: Hardware, Software Plans and Processing Fees
answer.text:
Clover Pricing

Simple, transparent pricing for in-person payments.

Software plans
Starter: $0/month. Accept cards and basic payments. Clover Go and Clover Flex supported.
Standard: $14.95/month per device. Adds reporting, inventory tracking and employee management.
Pro: $34.95/month per device. Adds advanced reporting, kitchen display integration and priority support.
Software plans are billed monthly and can be changed or cancelled at any time.

In-person processing
2.3% + 15¢ per tap, dip or swipe transaction on Starter, Standard and Pro plans.
Keyed-in transactions: 3.5% + 15¢.

Hardware is sold separately. Clover Flex starts at $89 upfront or $4/month device payment plan. Clover Mini starts at $699 upfront.
